name: bdi
description: Business Daily Insights: opportunity pipeline and AI proposal writer

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w tests/rules
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-bdi "npm run test -w tests/rules"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
